text: A股三大指数集体翻红，创业板指此前一度跌超1%，PCB、油气、游戏、煤炭等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股近2000只
text_en: The three major A-share indices all turned positive; the ChiNext Index had previously fallen more than 1%; PCB, oil and gas, gaming, and coal sectors led gains; nearly 2,000 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
